records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、陽桜莉さん！<CR>この七夕飾り、いい感じにできてると思わない？
records.en_original: Hiori! Hiori! Don't the Tanabata decorations look great?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori! Hiori! Don't the Tanabata decorations look great?
records.en: Hiori-san! Hiori-san!<CR>Don't the Tanabata decorations look great?

records.jp: ……うん。とっても綺麗だね
records.en_original: Yeah... They're really pretty.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... They're really pretty.
records.en: Yeah... They're really pretty.

records.jp: どうしたの！？<CR>いつもの陽桜莉さんっぽくないよ！？
records.en_original: Are you okay?! That doesn't sound like the Hiori I know!
records.en_auxiliary: Are you okay?! That doesn't sound like the Hiori I know!
records.en: Are you okay?! That<CR>doesn't sound like the Hiori-san I know!

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: 七夕飾りだよ？　短冊もあるんだよ？

records.en_auxiliary: The Tanabata decorations! There are paper slips to write our wishes on and everything!
records.en: The Tanabata decorations! There are paper slips to write our wishes on and everything!

records.jp: すごいすごーい！　私も願い事書くー！<CR>って、絶対テンションあがると思ってたのに
records.en_original: I thought you'd be bouncing off the walls with excitement.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you'd be bouncing off the walls with excitement.
records.en: I thought you'd be bouncing<CR>off the walls with excitement.

records.jp: さてはお主……陽桜莉殿の偽物であるな！？
records.en_original: Out with the truth, impostor! What have you done with the real Lady Hiori?!
records.en_auxiliary: Out with the truth, impostor! What have you done with the real Lady Hiori?!
records.en: Out with the truth, impostor! What have you done with the real Lady Hiori?!

records.jp: えっ！？　に、偽物！？<CR>違うよ、私は本物の陽桜莉で……
records.en_original: Huh?! I-impostor?! No way! I'm the real Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! I-impostor?! No way! I'm the real Hiori...
records.en: Huh?! I-impostor?! No<CR>way! I'm the real Hiori...

records.jp: ええい、神妙にいたせ！<CR>拙者が改めてくれるー！
records.en_original: Silence! There is but one way to verify your claims.
records.en_auxiliary: Silence! There is but one way to verify your claims.
records.en: Silence! There is but one<CR>way to verify your claims.

records.jp: えーっ！？
records.en_original: Wha?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha?!
records.en: Wha?!

records.jp: もう、愛央ちゃんってば！<CR>変なとこいっぱい触るんだから！
records.en_original: Hey, Ao! Come on! Stop touching me all over!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao! Come on! Stop touching me all over!
records.en: Hey, Ao-chan! Come on!<CR>Stop touching me all over!

records.jp: すみません……
records.en_original: Sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry...
records.en: Sorry...

records.jp: テンション低い陽桜莉さんって、<CR>なんか落ち着かなくて……つい……
records.en_original: I'm just not used to seeing you so deflated... I didn't know what to do, so...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just not used to seeing you so deflated... I didn't know what to do, so...
records.en: Seeing you so down just made<CR>me restless, Hiori-san, so I...

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃんなりに心配してくれてたんだ
records.en_original: You were worried about me...?
records.en_auxiliary: You were worried about me...?
records.en: ...So you were worried about me in your own way, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ありがとう、愛央ちゃん。<CR>私は大丈夫だから
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao. I'm fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao. I'm fine.
records.en: Thanks, Ao-chan.<CR>I'm fine.

records.jp: （もしかして、具合が悪いとか？<CR>顔色はいつも通りに見えるけど……）
records.en_original: (Could she be feeling under the weather? She doesn't look like it, though...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Could she be feeling under the weather? She doesn't look like it, though...)
records.en: (Could she be feeling under the weather?<CR>She doesn't look like it, though...)

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao?
records.en: Ao-chan?

records.jp: （いや……やっぱりちょっと頬が赤いかも？）
records.en_original: (Actually... Her cheeks do seem a bit red.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Actually... Her cheeks do seem a bit red.)
records.en: (Actually... Her cheeks do seem a bit red.)

records.jp: ど、どうしたの？　じっと見つめて……<CR>そんなに見つめられると、恥ずかしいよ
records.en_original: Wh-why are you staring at me? You're making me feel self-conscious, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why are you staring at me? You're making me feel self-conscious, Ao.
records.en: Wh-why are you staring at me? You're<CR>making me feel self-conscious, Ao.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんのことが……気になって……
records.en_original: I'm just...worried about you, Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just...worried about you, Hiori...
records.en: I'm just...worried about you, Hiori-san...

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: 見た感じじゃ分からないけど、<CR>実はどこか具合が悪かったりする？
records.en_original: You look okay, but is something the matter?
records.en_auxiliary: You look okay, but is something the matter?
records.en: You look okay, but is<CR>something the matter?

records.jp: そういう時は、我慢せずに教えて欲しいな。<CR>今日は教室に戻ってゆっくりした方が……
records.en_original: You can tell me anything, you know. Don't hold it all in. Why don't we go back to the classroom and—
records.en_auxiliary: You can tell me anything, you know. Don't hold it all in. Why don't we go back to the classroom and—
records.en: You can tell me anything, you know. Don't hold it all<CR>in. Why don't we go back to the classroom and—

records.jp: ……！<CR>だ、大丈夫！　私は元気いっぱいだよ！
records.en_original: ...I-I'm fine! I've never been better!
records.en_auxiliary: ...I-I'm fine! I've never been better!
records.en: ...I-I'm<CR>fine! I've never been better!

records.jp: ……そう？
records.en_original: ...Really?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Really?
records.en: ...Really?

records.jp: うん！　心配させちゃってごめんね！
records.en_original: Yeah! Sorry I made you worry!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Sorry I made you worry!
records.en: Yeah! Sorry I made you worry!

records.jp: ……はーっ。一瞬びっくりしちゃった……<CR>ほんとに恥ずかしい……私……
records.en_original: *Sigh* I was scared for a bit there... That's kind of embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* I was scared for a bit there... That's kind of embarrassing...
records.en: *Sigh* I was scared for a bit there...<CR>That's kind of embarrassing...

records.jp: でも……じゃあなんで？
records.en_original: But then...what's up?
records.en_auxiliary: But then...what's up?
records.en: But then...what's up?

records.jp: いつもの陽桜莉さんなら、<CR>もっとこう、ハツラツと……
records.en_original: You're usually more...I dunno, full of life...?
records.en_auxiliary: You're usually more...I dunno, full of life...?
records.en: You're usually more, you<CR>know, lively, Hiori-san...

records.jp: ん……ちょっといろいろ思い出してたんだ
records.en_original: Mm... I was just looking back on some things.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... I was just looking back on some things.
records.en: Mm... I was just looking back on some things.

records.jp: 私、七夕にはたくさん思い出があって
records.en_original: I have a lot of memories of Tanabata.
records.en_auxiliary: I have a lot of memories of Tanabata.
records.en: I have a lot of memories of Tanabata.

records.jp: 嬉しかったこととか、楽しかったこととか<CR>……悲しかったこととか、本当にいろいろ
records.en_original: Happy memories, fun memories...sad memories. All kinds of memories, really.
records.en_auxiliary: Happy memories, fun memories...sad memories. All kinds of memories, really.
records.en: Happy memories, fun memories...sad<CR>memories. All kinds of memories, really.

records.jp: でも、どれも私の大事な記憶……<CR>私の一部だなーって、改めて思ってね
records.en_original: But all of them are important memories... I realized that they're like a part of me.
records.en_auxiliary: But all of them are important memories... I realized that they're like a part of me.
records.en: But all of them are important memories...<CR>I realized that they're like a part of me.

records.jp: （陽桜莉さん、いつも明るい人だけど……<CR>今日は少しだけ印象が違うかも）
records.en_original: (Hiori's always so bright and cheerful...but she seems a little different today.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hiori's always so bright and cheerful...but she seems a little different today.)
records.en: (Hiori-san's always so bright and cheerful...but<CR>she seems a little different today.)

records.jp: ……なんだか今日は、陽桜莉さんを<CR>ちょっと遠くに感じちゃうな
records.en_original: I feel like there's a little distance between us today, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like there's a little distance between us today, Hiori.
records.en: I feel like there's a little distance<CR>between us today, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 当然だけど、陽桜莉さんのその思い出に<CR>私は存在してないからさ
records.en_original: Well, it's obvious when you think about it, but...I'm not in any of your memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it's obvious when you think about it, but...I'm not in any of your memories.
records.en: Obviously, I don't exist in those memories<CR>of yours, Hiori-san.

records.jp: あっ、ごめん！　せっかくふたりでいるのに<CR>愛央ちゃんの知らない思い出話なんて……
records.en_original: Oh! Sorry! I shouldn't go on about my own memories while the two of us are hanging out...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! Sorry! I shouldn't go on about my own memories while the two of us are hanging out...
records.en: Oh, sorry! We're together, and I'm going on<CR>about memories you don't even know, Ao-chan...

records.jp: ごめんなんてことないよ
records.en_original: It's nothing to apologize about.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nothing to apologize about.
records.en: It's nothing to apologize about.

records.jp: でもいつか、陽桜莉さんがいいって思ったら、<CR>改めてその思い出話を聞かせて欲しいな
records.en_original: But someday, whenever you feel it's right, I'd like to hear all about those memories.
records.en_auxiliary: But someday, whenever you feel it's right, I'd like to hear all about those memories.
records.en: But someday, when you feel ready, Hiori-san,<CR>I'd like you to tell me about those memories again.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: ……陽桜莉さんの横顔、綺麗だなぁ
records.en_original: ...You have a beautiful profile, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You have a beautiful profile, Hiori.
records.en: ...You have a beautiful profile, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ！？　き、急にどうしたの、愛央ちゃん。<CR>綺麗だなんて、そんな……
records.en_original: Huh? Beautiful? What are you talking about all of a sudden?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Beautiful? What are you talking about all of a sudden?
records.en: Huh?! W-what brought this on, Ao-chan?<CR>Calling me beautiful...

records.jp: ……恥ずかしいよ
records.en_original: It's embarrassing...
records.en_auxiliary: It's embarrassing...
records.en: It's embarrassing...

records.jp: 変かな？　本当にそう思ったんだけど
records.en_original: I didn't mean to be weird. I really meant it.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't mean to be weird. I really meant it.
records.en: I didn't mean to be weird. I really meant it.

records.jp: 綺麗で、なんだか目が離せないなって……
records.en_original: You're so beautiful that I can't take my eyes off of you...
records.en_auxiliary: You're so beautiful that I can't take my eyes off of you...
records.en: You're so beautiful that I can't take my eyes off of you...

records.jp: はうう……
records.en_original: Ugh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh...
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: ……陽桜莉さん、きっと私の知らない<CR>いろんなものを乗り越えてきたんだよね
records.en_original: I'm sure you've been through all sorts of things I don't know about, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure you've been through all sorts of things I don't know about, Hiori.
records.en: I'm sure you've been through all sorts<CR>of things I don't know about, Hiori-san.

records.jp: なんかこう言うのも変だけど……<CR>陽桜莉さん、お疲れ様
records.en_original: This might be a weird thing to say, but...good job, Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: This might be a weird thing to say, but...good job, Hiori.
records.en: This may sound strange, but...<CR>Hiori-san, you have really worked hard.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんのことだから、きっとこれまで<CR>一生懸命頑張ってきたんだよね
records.en_original: Knowing you, I bet you've worked really hard to make it this far.
records.en_auxiliary: Knowing you, I bet you've worked really hard to make it this far.
records.en: Knowing Hiori-san, you must have worked<CR>really hard all this time.

records.jp: ……そうだ！　ちょっと待ってね！
records.en_original: ...Oh, that reminds me! Wait here!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Oh, that reminds me! Wait here!
records.en: ...Oh, that reminds me! Wait here!

records.jp: できた！　陽桜莉さん、見て！<CR>私の今年のお願い事はこれでーす
records.en_original: There! Hiori, look! This is my wish for this year.
records.en_auxiliary: There! Hiori, look! This is my wish for this year.
records.en: There! Hiori-san, look!<CR>This is my wish for this year.

records.jp: 頑張ったぶん、陽桜莉さんに嬉しいことや<CR>楽しいことがたくさん訪れますように……
records.en_original: I wish that Hiori will be rewarded for all her hard work with an abundance of fun and happiness...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish that Hiori will be rewarded for all her hard work with an abundance of fun and happiness...
records.en: I wish that Hiori-san will be rewarded for all her<CR>hard work with an abundance of fun and happiness...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……？
records.en_original: Hiori...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...?
records.en: Hiori-san...?

records.jp: ご、ごめん。何か気を悪くすることしたかな？<CR>陽桜莉さんにノーコメント貫かれるなんて……
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry. Did I offend you? I didn't mean to...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sorry. Did I offend you? I didn't mean to...
records.en: S-sorry. Did I do something to upset you?<CR>I can't believe you're sticking to “no comment,” Hiori-san...

records.jp: ち……違うの！<CR>気を悪くしたとかじゃなくて……
records.en_original: N-no! I'm not offended...
records.en_auxiliary: N-no! I'm not offended...
records.en: N-no! I'm<CR>not offended...

records.jp: なんか……急に目が潤んじゃって。<CR>へへ……変だよね
records.en_original: Wh-why are my eyes all wet? Heh, that's weird...
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why are my eyes all wet? Heh, that's weird...
records.en: Wh-why are my eyes all wet? Heh,<CR>that's weird...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao-chan...

records.jp: これくらいしか、できなくて。その……
records.en_original: This is...all I can do...
records.en_auxiliary: This is...all I can do...
records.en: This is...all I can do...

records.jp: ……ありがとう、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: ...Thanks, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thanks, Ao.
records.en: ...Thanks, Ao-chan.

records.jp: いろいろ思い出してたから、ちょっとナイーブに<CR>なっちゃったかな？
records.en_original: Looking back on my memories earlier must have made me a bit emotional.
records.en_auxiliary: Looking back on my memories earlier must have made me a bit emotional.
records.en: Looking back on my memories earlier must have made<CR>me a bit emotional.

records.jp: でも、もう大丈夫。元気出てきた
records.en_original: But I'm okay now.
records.en_auxiliary: But I'm okay now.
records.en: But I'm okay now.

records.jp: 本当に？
records.en_original: Are you sure?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure?
records.en: Are you sure?

records.jp: うんっ。愛央ちゃんのおかげだよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Thanks to you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Thanks to you, Ao.
records.en: Yeah. Thanks to you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 頑張ったんだねって言ってくれて……<CR>嬉しかった
records.en_original: Your words gave me the encouragement I needed...
records.en_auxiliary: Your words gave me the encouragement I needed...
records.en: I was happy when you told me<CR>that I had worked hard.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの手、温かいね。<CR>もうちょっとだけ、こうしてていいかな
records.en_original: Your hand is so warm. Can we stay like this just a little longer?
records.en_auxiliary: Your hand is so warm. Can we stay like this just a little longer?
records.en: Your hand is warm, Ao-chan.<CR>Can we stay like this a little longer?

records.jp: もちろん！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんを元気づけられた……かな？<CR>よかった……）
records.en_original: (She seems to have cheered up...I think? I'm glad...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She seems to have cheered up...I think? I'm glad...)
records.en: (Did I manage to cheer Hiori-san up...?<CR>Thank goodness...)

records.jp: えっと……そうだ！　陽桜莉さん、喉渇いてない？
records.en_original: Uhh... Oh, I know! Hiori, you must be thirsty!
records.en_auxiliary: Uhh... Oh, I know! Hiori, you must be thirsty!
records.en: Uhh... Oh, I know! Hiori-san, you must be thirsty!

records.jp: 甘い炭酸飲料とか飲んだら、こう、<CR>元気が出るんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: I'm sure drinking something sweet and fizzy will make you feel better!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure drinking something sweet and fizzy will make you feel better!
records.en: I'm sure drinking something sweet and<CR>fizzy will make you feel better!

records.jp: 飲み物以外でも、欲しい物があったら教えてね！<CR>お菓子とかがいいかな！？　それとも……
records.en_original: Let me know if there's anything else you want! Some sweets maybe? Or how about...
records.en_auxiliary: Let me know if there's anything else you want! Some sweets maybe? Or how about...
records.en: Let me know if there's anything else you want!<CR>Some sweets maybe? Or how about...

records.jp: ……ふふっ。ありがと、愛央ちゃん。<CR>愛央ちゃんは優しいね
records.en_original: Hehe... Thanks, Ao. You're so nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... Thanks, Ao. You're so nice.
records.en: Hehe... Thanks, Ao-chan.<CR>You're so nice.

records.jp: さっき短冊に書いてくれたお願い事も、<CR>すっごく嬉しかったよ
records.en_original: The wish you wrote on the slip earlier made me really happy too.
records.en_auxiliary: The wish you wrote on the slip earlier made me really happy too.
records.en: The wish you wrote on the slip earlier made<CR>me really happy too.

records.jp: そ、そう？　それならいいんだけど……
records.en_original: R-really? That's good...
records.en_auxiliary: R-really? That's good...
records.en: R-really? That's good...

records.jp: そうだ、私も短冊に願い事書こうっと！
records.en_original: That's it! I should make a wish too!
records.en_auxiliary: That's it! I should make a wish too!
records.en: That's it! I should make a wish too!

records.jp: ……みんなが笑顔で過ごせるようにする！<CR>うん、こんな感じかな
records.en_original: ...I wish that I'll be able to put a smile on everybody's face! Yeah, that sounds good.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I wish that I'll be able to put a smile on everybody's face! Yeah, that sounds good.
records.en: ...I wish that I'll be able to put a smile on everybody's<CR>face! Yeah, that sounds good.

records.jp: 願い事というよりは、決意表明みたいだね
records.en_original: That sounds more like a resolution than a wish.
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds more like a resolution than a wish.
records.en: That sounds more like a resolution than a wish.

records.jp: 私にできることは精一杯やりたいなって
records.en_original: I just wanna help however I can!
records.en_auxiliary: I just wanna help however I can!
records.en: I just wanna help however I can!

records.jp: ……あ。なんか急にお腹が空いてきたかも！<CR>愛央ちゃん、一緒に食堂にいこっか
records.en_original: Ahh, now I'm hungry all of a sudden! Wanna go to the cafeteria, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, now I'm hungry all of a sudden! Wanna go to the cafeteria, Ao?
records.en: Ahh, now I'm hungry all of a sudden! Wanna<CR>go to the cafeteria, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 甘い炭酸飲料に合うようなお菓子、<CR>作ってもらおうよ！
records.en_original: Let's get something that goes with a sweet, fizzy drink!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get something that goes with a sweet, fizzy drink!
records.en: Let's get something that goes with a<CR>sweet, fizzy drink!
